settings.heading: Care is a daily practice.
settings.text: PAWSITIVE.LIVING began with a simple observation: the dogs we love most are cared for in small moments, every single day. We make a considered few essentials for those moments — formulated thoughtfully, designed quietly, and made to earn their place in your routine.

settings.heading: For paws and noses
settings.text: A considered balm for the parts of your dog that meet the world. Fragrance-free, made for daily use, through every season.

settings.heading: The complete ritual
settings.text: Both essentials in one considered set. Balm first, then mist — the order is part of the ritual.

settings.heading: For the coat
settings.text: A lightweight, fragrance-free finishing mist for a naturally polished coat. The refined final step.

settings.heading: Everyday rituals, considered.
settings.subheading: A small, deliberate line. Nothing more than your dog needs, nothing less than they deserve.

settings.heading: For the pets still waiting for home.
settings.statement: $2 from every order goes to organizations caring for homeless pets. Our founder spent two years without stable housing, and saw how much a dog can mean when you have little else. This company grew from that — every order carries it forward.

settings.heading: EVERYDAY CARE, ELEVATED.
settings.text: Thoughtfully developed essentials for the rituals that matter most.

settings.heading: Notes on considered care.
settings.text: Occasional letters on rituals, formulations, and the dogs that inspire them. No noise.
Every ingredient earns its place. Nothing fashionable, nothing filler.
settings.title: Thoughtful formulation

settings.text: No fragrance, essential oils, or masking agents. Ever.
settings.title: Fragrance-free, always

settings.text: Nothing is listed or promised until it is tested and true.
settings.title: Verified before claimed

settings.statement: Exceptional care is not an occasional gesture. It is an everyday ritual — small, deliberate acts of attention, repeated with love.
